course.title: Statistics for Planners-II
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: The manufacturer of a certain type of electric bulbs claims that his bulbs have (15) a mean life of 25 months with a standard deviation 5 months. A random sample of such bulbs gives the following value: Life in month: 24, 26, 30, 20, 20, 18. Can the producer claim to be valid at 1% level of significance?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
